properties.notes: ERE/0916/0042 planning permission: Alterations to the first and second floors of the former Ilkeston Co-op building to create 69 residential apartments. The proposals include external alterations to the fabric of the building, extensions to the roof and additional and replacement windows. A resident’s gym and car parking would be provided as part of the development. The site is recorded complete as at 31st March 2019. This site is in the SHLAA2019 Ref 390.
